phase: Published; live browser checks are recorded in mobile-complete-production-2026-11-23.json
environment: Actual application components in the Codex in-app browser, isolated local data and blocked external service calls
limitations: Viewport QA is not physical-device or native-keyboard certification.
Layout receipts and individual flow receipts are listed separately. A route render does not certify every operation on that route.
Provider financial operations, external OAuth and production job/replay actions were not exercised.
Legacy MLB stays hidden/off-season. Existing publication records and ten owner approvals are preserved.
fixes: Explore: height-only lazy-card reservation, shrinkable grid children and wrapping tool links.
Community chat: viewport-sized conversation, explicit-entry alignment, single-channel duplication removed, short-screen content minimum and composer clearance.
Phone controls: 44px main, dialog, navigation, account, search, notification, creator, forum and workspace actions.
Settings: local navigation collapses by available content width; team selection reflows by container width.
Creator and shared legacy dialogs: visible-viewport sizing, 16px fields and 44px wizard/payout actions.
Charts: 44px native observation scrubber, missing-value handling and accessible readouts.
Sharing: HTTP failures cannot download an error body as a PNG; clipboard fallback and native-share errors have clear feedback.
Member identity: badge overlays verified and floating VOLT hidden behind dialogs and active phone conversations; small floating mascot retained elsewhere.
Search save action has an accessible name; creator promotion avoids a duplicate heading.
Review inventory includes launch, saved research preferences and creator checkout-return pages with a valid fixture offer.
